enchantments.tooltip: Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Insightful Dexterity +1: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +1 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
Speed +15%: +15% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 5% bonus to attack speed.
Reflex Save +4: This item gives a +4 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.
Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
